command:
import socket
import sys
import time

host = sys.argv[1]
port = int(sys.argv[2])
duration = float(sys.argv[3])
deadline = time.monotonic() + duration
sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
payload = b"bpfbench-cilium-udp" * 4
sent = 0
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    try:
        sock.sendto(payload, (host, port))
        sent += 1
    except OSError:
        pass
print(sent)
